en: Fixed `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` set only in remote managed settings no longer applying once the stored copy had expired, which let sessions start without policy when the server could not be reached
zh: 修复仅在远程托管设置中设置的 `forceRemoteSettingsRefresh` 在已存储副本过期后不再生效的问题，该问题会导致无法连接服务器时 session 在没有策略的情况下启动
